do_not_repeat_risks: Do not treat games/emulation metadata as game identity, ROM or disc authenticity, compatibility correctness, legal acquisition, playability, installability, rights clearance, malware safety, privacy safety, content safety, production coverage, or public truth.
Do not use fixture replay or blocked probes as live access approval.
Do not let games/emulation metadata become query, fetch, download, upload, hash-submission, execution, acquisition, scraping, crawling, bypass, restricted-source, source-sync, or action permission.
emulator_action_candidate_gaps: Action candidates remain blocked and grant no emulate, install, execute, acquire, download, mirror, upload, or launch permission.
emulator_compatibility_gaps: Compatibility candidates are not verified compatibility, playability, configuration approval, or execution permission.
fixture_gaps: Fixtures are synthetic/public-safe and do not prove live games/emulation metadata behavior.
game_relation_gaps: Game relation candidates are not relation truth, duplicate truth, storefront acquisition truth, or emulator playability truth.
game_software_identity_gaps: Game/software identity candidates require review before any game identity use.
h11_handoff_recommendation: H11-BUNDLE-01 may start policy-pack-only work for storefront and app-store sources.
j1_k_l_deferral_recommendation: J1 risky actions, K semantic/AI, and L wider clients remain deferred unless explicit gates open.
live_probe_gaps: Blocked live probes provide gate evidence but no completed network metadata response.
normalizer_gaps: Normalizers cover metadata fixture shapes, not ROMs, ISOs, discs, CHDs, BIOS/firmware, game binaries, emulators, installers, launchers, patches, assets, screenshots, scraping, crawling, execution, or restricted-source access.
notes: Postmortem recommends H11 policy packs, not risky actions or production readiness.
platform_release_edition_gaps: Platform/release/edition candidates are not release truth, platform truth, compatibility proof, or acquisition permission.
policy_gaps: source-specific live probe approvals remain absent
preservation_hashset_gaps: Hash-set candidates are not hash-set truth, authenticity proof, legal acquisition proof, safety proof, download permission, or hash-submission permission.
restricted_source_policy_gaps: Rights-sensitive ROM/disc-image, BIOS/firmware, crack/key/serial, leaked/proprietary, private library, account-bound storefront, and restricted game sources remain policy-blocked by default.
review_mapping_gaps: Review seeds are not human review decisions and are not persisted.
rights_safety_gaps: Rights/safety candidates are not rights clearance, legal acquisition truth, malware safety, content safety, privacy safety, or production readiness.
risks: Live H10 metadata probes remain blocked pending operator approval.
rom_disc_media_identity_gaps: ROM/disc/media candidates are not media truth, authenticity proof, safety proof, playability, or acquisition permission.
source_os_reuse_assessment: H10 reused H0-H9 Source OS review gates while preserving game/emulation-specific rights, payload, action, identity, and safety boundaries.
what_failed: No H10 source has committed operator approval for a live metadata probe.
what_worked: Fourteen H10 games/emulation sources have policy packs, fixtures, normalizers, replay outputs, fail-closed live-probe envelopes, and review previews.
Game/software identity, platform/release/edition, emulator compatibility, preservation hash-set, ROM/disc/media, relation, action, and rights/safety candidates remain review-gated and candidate-only.
Live-probe outputs failed closed or stayed dry-preflight when committed source approvals were missing.
